design: Balanced full-rank parameter boxes with dense shared capacity constraints; independent all-active-subset global references on the small problems. All parameter directions have the same singular value. For fixed q and seed, G uses leading columns of the same full orthogonal matrix. Fixed-q=32 comparisons therefore increase latent dimension without changing the target or existing latent columns. A separate rotated folded-ball family has exact global risks and affine zero-penalty controls. Every timing repetition starts a fresh query pipeline, including forward setup, all forward queries, sampled-anchor solves, upper-risk calculation, separation SOCPs and bookkeeping. All planned outcomes, including non-detections and failures, are retained.
